post.summary: This API initiates the process of generating campaigns for the Ready Proposal
post.description:
This API validates the proposal details, sets its status to statusId 5 (Processing), then
asynchronously generates the IO and campaigns. The target proposal must currently have
statusId 6 (Ready) or 4 (Failed) -- any other status is rejected with "Proposal Status is
invalid". On successful completion of the async step, the proposal is transitioned to
statusId 1 (Converted) with a real ioId assigned -- this is a one-way transition after
which edit/download/restore operations that require Ready/Failed/Expired status will start
failing for this proposal.

post.summary: Upload NPI list (CSV/XLSX) for HCP Planner
post.description:
Upload an NPI list file (CSV or Excel XLSX) for HCP targeting.

Expected client behaviour:
- File must contain a single column named 'npi' (case-insensitive).
- Both CSV and Excel (.xlsx) formats are supported.
- Optional planId may be provided when replacing a file during plan edit.

Server process:
1. Persist multipart bytes temporarily.
2. Detect file type (CSV/XLSX).
3. Validate header & per-row format.
4. Upload to S3 and persist DB metadata.
5. Return file metadata + row/column counts.

IDs when allCreativeTypesSelected is true, otherwise creativeTypeIds); dimension 2 (npi) must equal

when allDeviceTypesSelected is true, otherwise deviceTypeIds); dimension 5 (audience type) must equal
the union of selectedAudienceTypeIds across audienceBlocks.

the top-level npiTypeIds; dimension 3 (partner) must equal the set of dataPartners[].id across all
audienceBlocks; dimension 4 (device) must equal planLevelTargeting.devices (all real device type IDs
when allDeviceTypesSelected is true, otherwise deviceTypeIds); dimension 5 (audience type) must equal
